reasons.oats.session_unobservable: Its server cannot see its session.
reasons.oats.launch_prompt_waiting: It is waiting at a startup prompt.
reasons.oats.channel_not_loaded: Its message channel did not load.
reasons.oats.channel_stream_down: Its message channel is not connected.
reasons.oats.readiness_unavailable: Its server could not check it.
reasons.oats.wake_not_registered: It is not registered for messages.
reasons.oats.receive_unknown: Its server cannot tell whether it receives messages.
reasons.oats.grant_expiring: Its connection expires within a day.
reasons.oats.joined_team_poll_only: It checks for messages only now and then.
